name: Qwen 3.7 Plus
short: Alibaba's Qwen3.7 Plus GUI-agent tier on the Max backbone (1M native, 128K Zen text-only) for coding/agents; GPQA 90.0%, LiveCodeBench 89.6%.
standout: The GUI-agent tier: it drives real interfaces — screens, apps, clicks — on top of the Max backbone, not just APIs and terminals.
tradeoff: The Zen lane is text-only with a smaller window, so the full GUI experience is tied to Alibaba’s hosted API.
